countdowns.name: GTA 6
countdowns.note: Grand Theft Auto VI, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, midnight local time

facts.text: GTA 6 sold an estimated 24.58 million copies and made about $2.36 billion through launch day, roughly 75% of it on PS5 (Sensor Tower estimate; Take-Two hasn't released official numbers).
GTA 6 streams hit 125.47 million hours watched in the first 24 hours, peaking at 7.91 million viewers at once across Twitch, YouTube and Kick.
GTA 6's Twitch peak of 3.31 million viewers makes it the most-watched game ever on Twitch, passing League of Legends' 2022 World Championship final.
GTA 6 broke the internet download record twice in one week, peaking at 33.03 terabits per second through DE-CIX's global exchanges the night before launch.
GTA 6 holds a 99 on Metacritic across 147 critic reviews, tying the highest score the site has ever recorded.
More than 2.1 million players in the US and UK played GTA 6 early by switching their console region to New Zealand.
GTA VI Trailer 1 pulled 90,421,491 YouTube views in 24 hours, a Guinness World Record for a non-music video.
